ACT V OF 1986
ACT V OF 1986
SENATE (ELECTION)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986
An Act further to amend the Senate
(Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 28th December, 1986]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 23rd
December, 1986, and is hereby published for general information :-.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Senate (Election) (Amendment)
Act, 1986.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 13, Act LI of 1975

ACT V OF 1986
ACT V OF 1986
SENATE (ELECTION)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986
An Act further to amend the Senate
(Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 28th December, 1986]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 23rd
December, 1986, and is hereby published for general information :-.
2. Amendment of section 13,
Act LI of 1975.--In the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975),
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 13 for subsection (5) the
following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(5) Where
the nomination of a candidate has been rejected under this section by a
Returning Officer, an appeal shall lie, within two days of the scrutiny day, to
the Commissioner; and any order passed by the Commissioner on such appeal shall
be final.".

The following Act of

4. Amendment of section 82-A,
Act LI of 1975.--In the said Act, in section 82-A,-
(a) in subsection (1), for the words, brackets,

272" the words "into two groups" shall be substituted ; and
(b) in subsection (4), the words, brackets, letter and
figure "referred to in paragraph (g) of Article 272" shall be
omitted.
